description: Epoch AI 'AI Chip Owners' dataset — installed AI chips by owner and chip type over quarters.

body.how_to_read: Cumulative and per-quarter installed-chip counts/compute by owner, split by chip type and by designer. Read each CSV header for exact columns. Relevant to demand-side chip deployment.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'AI Chip Owners' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
